question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Final answer: product with smallest percentage-point change in share among top 20% products
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        u.cust_city_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers u ON s.cust_id = u.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON u.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY u.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cs1.cust_city_id
    FROM city_sales cs1
    JOIN city_sales cs2 ON cs1.cust_city_id = cs2.cust_city_id
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
      AND cs1.total_sales > 0
      AND (cs2.total_sales - cs1.total_sales) * 100.0 / cs1.total_sales >= 20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers u ON s.cust_id = u.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON u.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND u.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
      AND s.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM products)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(quarter_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranking AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as sales_quintile
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales
    FROM product_ranking
    WHERE sales_quintile = 1
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(quarter_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_pct)
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pq.prod_id,
        pq.calendar_quarter_id,
        pq.quarter_sales,
        qt.total_sales as quarter_total,
        pq.quarter_sales * 100.0 / qt.total_sales as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pq
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
    WHERE pq.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_pct)
)
SELECT p.prod_name
FROM product_shares ps1
JOIN product_shares ps2 ON ps1.prod_id = ps2.prod_id
JOIN products p ON ps1.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE ps1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
  AND ps2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
ORDER BY ABS(ps2.share_pct - ps1.share_pct) ASC
LIMIT 1

    SELECT cs1.cust_city_id

    JOIN city_sales cs2 ON cs1.cust_city_id = cs2.cust_city_id
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
      AND cs1.total_sales > 0
      AND (cs2.total_sales - cs1.total_sales) * 100.0 / cs1.total_sales >= 20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers u ON s.cust_id = u.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON u.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND u.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
      AND s.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM products)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(quarter_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranking AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as sales_quintile
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales
    FROM product_ranking

),
quarter_totals AS (
